div.head: VIII Atr 43.1
div.ab: ⁊ utan God lufian innewerdre heortan ⁊ Godes laga gíman, swa wel swa we betst magon.
⁊ utan God lufian innewerdre heortan ⁊ Godes laga gíman, swa wel swa we betst magon.
And utan God lufian innewerdre heortan and Godes laga giman, swa wel swa we betst magon.
Und lasst uns Gott aus innerstem Herzen lieben und Gottes Gesetze achten, so gut wie wir bestens können.
And let us love God from our inmost hearts and heed God's laws as well as we best can.
And let us love God from our inmost heart and observe his laws to the best of our ability.
And let us love God with our inmost heart and heed God’s laws as well as ever we can.
And let us love God with our innermost heart and heed his laws as best as we can.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.

note.seg: Möglicherweise war V Atr 1. 34. VIIa 2, 1 ebenfalls von Einfluss. Vielleicht benutzt durch I Cn 21. God lufjan inwerdre heortan predigt Hom. n. Wulfstan 189
V Atr 1. 34. VIIa 2, 1 may possibly have been an influence as well. Perhaps used by I Cn 21. God lufjan inwerdre heortan, preaches Hom. n. Wulfstan 189
Wie in V Atr 35 stand im Archetyp von VIII Atr vielleicht ealmihtigne, da Consil. omnipotentem bietet
As in V Atr 35, the archetype of VIII Atr perhaps read ealmihtigne, since Consil. has omnipotentem
Cf. V Atr. 1; 34; VI, 1; 42; Wulfstan, p. 189.
